title: Cleaning the House
context: Sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, taking out the trash — chores have their own exact verbs in English, and 'clean' alone won't carry you far.
contextPersian: جارو کردن، جاروبرقی کشیدن، گردگیری، بیرون بردن زباله — هر کار خانه فعل دقیق خودش را دارد و «clean» به تنهایی کافی نیست.

expressions.example: I spend Saturday mornings doing the housework.
expressions.examplePersian: صبح‌های شنبه را صرف کارهای خانه می‌کنم.

expressions.example: Can you vacuum the carpet in the living room?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌شود فرش پذیرایی را جاروبرقی بکشی؟

expressions.example: I'll sweep the kitchen floor after dinner.
expressions.examplePersian: بعد از شام کف آشپزخانه را جارو می‌کنم.

expressions.example: The floor's sticky — it needs mopping.
expressions.examplePersian: زمین چسبناک است — باید تی کشیده شود.

expressions.example: I dusted the shelves and wiped down the table.
expressions.examplePersian: قفسه‌ها را گردگیری کردم و میز را دستمال کشیدم.

expressions.example: Wipe down the counters when you finish cooking.
expressions.examplePersian: وقتی آشپزی تمام شد، کابینت‌ها را دستمال بکش.

expressions.example: Don't forget to take out the trash tonight.
expressions.examplePersian: یادت نرود امشب زباله را بیرون ببری.
expressions.note: British English: take out the rubbish/bins.

expressions.example: Let's put everything away before the guests arrive.
expressions.examplePersian: قبل از رسیدن مهمان‌ها همه چیز را سر جایش بگذاریم.

expressions.example: Give me twenty minutes to tidy up the living room.
expressions.examplePersian: بیست دقیقه وقت بده پذیرایی را مرتب کنم.
expressions.note: Tidy up = make neat; clean = remove dirt. A room can be tidy but not clean.

expressions.example: I make the bed as soon as I get up.
expressions.examplePersian: به محض اینکه بیدار می‌شوم تخت را مرتب می‌کنم.

exercises.prompt: The carpet is dirty. You need to ___ it.
exercises.explanationPersian: فرش → جاروبرقی (vacuum)؛ کف سخت → جارو یا تی.

exercises.explanation: Take out the trash — بیرون بردن زباله.
exercises.explanationPersian: بیرون بردن زباله: take out the trash.

exercises.prompt: Your room is messy but not dirty. Before guests come you should ___.
exercises.explanation: Messy → tidy up (make neat). Dirty → clean.

exercises.source: من هر روز صبح تختم را مرتب می‌کنم.
acceptedAnswers: I make my bed every morning.
Every morning I make my bed.
I make the bed every morning.
exercises.explanation: Make the bed — مرتب کردن تخت.
exercises.explanationPersian: مرتب کردن تخت: make the bed.

exercises.source: باید فرش را جارو برقی بکشم.
acceptedAnswers: I need to vacuum the carpet.
I have to vacuum the carpet.
I've got to vacuum the carpet.
exercises.explanationPersian: vacuum the carpet یعنی فرش را با جارو برقی تمیز کردن.

exercises.explanation: tidy up = put things in order

speakingTask.instruction: Describe how you clean your home — which chores you do, in what order.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: توصیف کن چطور خانه‌ات را تمیز می‌کنی — چه کارهایی و به چه ترتیبی.
modelSentences: On weekends I do the housework.
First I tidy up and put things away.
Then I vacuum the carpets and mop the kitchen floor.
Finally I wipe down the counters and take out the trash.

roleplay.aiRole: The learner's flatmate planning weekend cleaning together
roleplay.learnerRole: You're dividing up the chores with your flatmate
roleplay.objective: Negotiate who does which chore, using the chore verbs naturally
roleplay.context: Saturday morning. The flat needs a proper clean before guests come tomorrow. Divide tasks, disagree a little, agree a plan.
roleplay.opening: Okay, this place is a mess and your friends come tomorrow. How do you want to split the cleaning?
